_doc: Held-out eval slice registry (L13 / R45). Each slice carries added_in_turn — the loop turn at which it entered the instrument. Cross-turn comparison (server/coordination/lib/promotion_rule.mjs) uses ONLY slices present in both turns being compared, so adding a slice extends the instrument WITHOUT invalidating any historical turn's score (frozen-for-honesty). Slices are additive-only: never remove or renumber an existing slice; append new ones with a later added_in_turn.
